|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Uncharted Settlements]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-91E-Uncharted_Settlements-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Uncharted Settlements]].
* '''Original''' ([[Uncharted Settlements]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base. Organized Attack, S-Foils, Revolution, Your Destiny (unless you chose Rebel/Rebel Starship), and [Virtual Block 4] Ellorrs Madak are canceled. You may not deploy operatives or [Maintenance] cards. Force generation at Endor system may not be canceled. Unless Leave Them To Me on table, opponent's combat vehicles, Dark Jedi, [Maintenance] cards, and [Permanent Weapon] cards are deploy +2 to Rebel Cell sites. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 30). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Uncharted Settlements (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “Ellors Madak” for “Ellorrs Madak” (spelling as published) and “S-foils” for “S-Foils” (it writes the icons as “[Virtual Block 4]”, “[Maintenance]”, “[Permanent Weapon]” and “(Immune to Alter.)”, which is notation only, and adds the credit line “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”): “Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base. Organized Attack, S-foils, Revolution, Your Destiny (unless you chose Rebel/Rebel Starship), and [Virtual Block 4] Ellors Madak are canceled. You may not deploy operatives or [Maintenance] cards. Force generation at Endor system may not be canceled. Unless Leave Them To Me on table, opponent's combat vehicles, Dark Jedi, [Maintenance] cards, and [Permanent Weapon] cards are deploy +2 to Rebel Cell sites. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. (Immune to Alter.)(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”<ref name="cl-1240_91-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
